items.reason: Describes the same positional pairing of error_ids with get_multi values, which can attach event details to the wrong error ID.
Describes the same truthiness checks that treat zero-valued age or timestamp fields as absent and bypass mutual exclusion.
Describes a detector update reading detector_type instead of type. No golden issue covers this field-name mismatch.
Describes the same feature-flagged table visualization receiving hardcoded empty props instead of query results.

Describes a potential crash from accessing missing meta in the visualization. This differs from the golden issue about passing empty columns and data; fixing the metadata guard would not fix that issue.
Describes analytics being recorded before the preprod feature gate. No golden issue covers this ordering.
Describes unencoded attribute keys interpolated into a request path. This is separate from the golden issue about missing organization identity in the attribute-keys cache key.
Describes unbounded browser-report batch processing and metrics amplification. This differs from the golden issues about field validation and logging sensitive raw reports.
Describes the same incorrect positional pairing of error IDs with nodestore results when ordering differs or nodes are missing.
Describes the same zero-value bypass of age/timestamp mutual exclusion caused by truthiness checks.
Describes the same reliance on get_multi value order and positional alignment when associating event details with error IDs.
